name: segmentation
label: Segmentation
summary: Pipeline variants that differ from the baseline only in the segmentation step.
description: Each parameter set is a full preprocessing pipeline in which only the segmentation step is swapped (binning, cellpose, cellposev4, custom_segmentation, stardist, watershed). All other steps are fixed to the baseline: segmentation: custom_segmentation → assignment: basic_transcript_assignment → count_aggregation: basic_count_aggregation → qc_filter: basic_qc_filter → calculate_cell_volume: alpha_shapes → normalization: normalize_by_volume → cell_type_assignment: tacco → expression_correction: no_correction → gene_efficiency_correction: no_correction.
